text:
Avery: Quick sync — Fjord Systems interview: they can do Wed 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT. Need legal sign-off on the quote and a signed release form. Can we pick a slot and send release docs today?

Sanjay: Wed 10am PT works for me. I'll draft the short quote for approval. @Oliver (Legal) can you check the legal wording once I paste it?

Oliver (Legal): Paste the exact quote here please. Quantitative claims need to be sourced and we need a signed release (not verbal).

Maya: I'll book Wed 10am PT and send the calendar invite. Recording will be remote, 30 min max. Do we want a one-sentence hero quote + 2 bullets of outcomes?

Sanjay: Draft quote: "Fjord reduced latency by 4x and cut inference costs by 60% on our production workloads." — cc @Oliver (Legal)

Oliver (Legal): Heads up — '4x' and '60%' are specific claims. We need the timeframe and a supporting metric (internal deck or spreadsheet). If they can't provide, change to 'significantly reduced latency and inference costs.' Also need a data source line in the release.

Avery: I'll ask them to confirm the numbers in email and attach any benchmarking docs. If they can't share numbers, we'll use the softer language.

Riley (Fjord): We can confirm and send the benchmarking deck by EOD today. Wed 10am PT confirmed on our side. We'll sign the release form — please send it over. :thumbsup:

Maya: Sending calendar invite now. @legal-ops can you drop the standard release template link?

legal-ops: https://drive.redwood/release-templates/customer-release-v2.pdf — use the "customer quote + analytics" template. I'll also attach an editable Google Doc for signature.

Oliver (Legal): I uploaded a quick redline with clarifications (dates, data-source sentence, GDPR opt-out clause). Please review before sending to the customer. Link: https://legal.redwood/rdl/1769502468-redline

Sanjay: Thanks. Plan: once we have signed release + deck, I'll finalize the hero line and 2 bullets and start a one-message approvals thread for copy + quote sign-off tomorrow AM. Tagging @Avery for final publish timing and @sales-handoff for lead routing.

Avery: Perfect. Tentative publish: short blog + conjoined tweet thread, webinar demo follow-up in 2 weeks if customer is interested. For now we just need the signed release + source doc by EOD to keep Wed slot.

Riley (Fjord): Got it — deck and signed release coming today. Looking forward to the session.

Maya: Calendar invite sent (Wed 10am PT). I added a 15-min pre-call for the internal run-through. See you then.
